args.purpose: Count total delivered orders with 1-star reviews and those that arrived late (after estimated delivery date)
args.sql:
WITH one_star_reviews AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT or.order_id
  FROM order_reviews or
  WHERE or.review_score = 1
),
delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_estimated_delivery_date
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_one_star_delivered,
  SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_delivered_customer_date > oe.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as late_arrivals
FROM delivered_orders od
JOIN one_star_reviews oe ON od.order_id = oe.order_id
